static_traits.name: Roger
static_traits.social_status: Limited social interaction, Withdrawn due to wheelchair and insufficient confidence; having a supportive colleague to confide in
static_traits.medical_history: A medical condition diagnosed years ago requiring wheelchair dependence; without other significant physical illness besides that condition; not yet received psychotherapy before
static_traits.language_features: Honest, good cooperativeness; strong self-Reflection ability; tense but hopeful emotionally

basic_info.main_problem: Despite extensive reading, I feel I am not a good reader, which causes me pain and inferiority.
basic_info.core_demands: These inadequacy feelings began affecting my self-esteem and overall well-being, and affecting my Work performance at the museum. I want to stop this not-good-enough feeling, enjoy reading again without being plagued by negative thoughts.
growth_experiences: A medical condition diagnosed years ago forced me to rely on a wheelchair, limiting physical activity. Since then, reading became the main way to escape and pass time, but as I relied more on reading, I began comparing my reading speed with others more frequently, especially When facing complex texts more easily triggering Self-doubt and inferiority. This experience gradually intensified stress and Anxiety, affecting my Work performance and social interaction (Reduced socializing, more Self-doubt).

core_beliefs: I am not a good enough reader
I am worse than others / I am incompetent

special_situations.event: When discussing books with friends, comparing reading speed and comprehension expression
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my reading speed and expression are not like my peers', it shows I am not good enough, inferior
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Signs up for speed-reading techniques and online courses, trying to prove herself and improve speed
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never be as good as them.

special_situations.event: Reading slows down and comprehension is strenuous with complex texts
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot handle complex texts with ease, it shows I am not a good reader
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tends to avoid challenging texts, reduces contact to lower frustration
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am just slow, cannot keep up.

special_situations.event: When the job requires extensive reading and explaining content to visitors
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not understand/express fast enough at Work, it proves I am not competent
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Produces avoidance tendencies; reduces attempts at harder materials or tasks
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: No matter what I do, I will never get better.

special_situations.event: After being restricted in activities by a medical condition, reading became the main pastime and self-consolation
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Since reading is my main thing, I should read faster and better, otherwise I am unqualified
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Putting pressure on oneself, continually practicing skills and harshly evaluating oneself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I should read faster, otherwise it shows I am not good enough.

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be seen as a capable, recognized reader and professional
core_conflict.fear: Fearing appearing inferior after comparison, being evaluated as incompetent, thus Impaired self-esteem and alienation
defense_goal: Reduces the risk of being evaluated by avoiding challenging texts and social comparison
Maintaining control and self-esteem through constant training and rational Interpretation

object_relations.object_representation: Friends are relaxed, more excellent others who may judge oneself

object_relations.self_representation: The explainer who is easily questioned at work
object_relations.object_representation: Visitors/others are strict evaluators who may pick out faults

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing books with friends, entering comparison situations
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Treating others as better judges, believing she does not deserve recognition
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Tending to use self-deprecating statements, lowered tone, avoiding asserting views, expressing 'I am not as good as them'.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor or others inquire about the causes of differences
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: By emphasizing external factors such as practice and educational differences, pushes emotions to the background in order to gain a mental sense of control
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Adopts an objective analytical tone, lists possible factors, reduces the expression of emotional vocabulary and subjective feelings.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When needing to directly face negative automatic thoughts and do cognitive restructuring
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Reducing current Anxiety by thinking ahead and preparing future adjustments
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: using forward-looking and planning language, setting small-step goals, steady and pragmatic tone.

manifestations: Medical condition limits physical activity; needs to rely on a wheelchair
Treats reading as the main escape and pastime, feels one 'must' perform better at reading
outcomes: Limited sense of self-worth and ability

manifestations: Limited social interaction, Withdrawn due to insufficient confidence and wheelchair use
Mainly communicates with one supportive colleague; overall interpersonal support is lacking
outcomes: Social withdrawal and persisting Negative emotions

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequent self-comparison and Self-denial ('I am not as good as them')
Over-focusing on inadequacy and failure When facing complex texts
Hesitating and Withdrawn at Work and socially

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Sets rigid 'should' standards for reading speed and comprehension (feeling one must be faster and better)
Using others' performance as absolute reference, not yet adjusting standards to her own situation

positive_force: Reads a lot; has the habit of sustained engagement
Able to self-Reflect and identify the influence of pressure and thinking patterns
Positive attitude, willing to try change (willing to do restructuring and practice)
Has a supportive colleague at work to confide in
negative_force: Excessive comparison and negating the positive (mental filtering and negating the positive)
Self-worth excessively bound to reading speed and performance
Medical condition limiting activities, bringing ongoing pressure and Anxiety

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding reading or Avoiding challenging (complex) texts
antecedent: When comparing reading speed or discussing books with others
When needing to quickly understand and explain to visitors at work
target_behavior.core_reason: Directly equating reading speed with personal worth; in the context of medical condition and pressure, negatively attributing 'slowness' and triggering Self-doubt
target_behavior.function: Avoiding the Anxiety and shame brought by being compared and evaluated
target_behavior.consequence: Further impaired reading experience, hindered ability improvement, Decline in work performance

target_behavior.behavior: Social withdrawal, reducing interaction with others
antecedent: Feeling inferior when discussing books with friends
Insufficient confidence and discomfort from wheelchair use
target_behavior.core_reason: Fearing being seen as incompetent, appearing inferior after comparison, thus Self-protective Withdrawal
target_behavior.function: Avoiding external negative evaluation and Impaired self-esteem
target_behavior.consequence: Decreased interpersonal support, worsened Loneliness and Self-doubt
